name: localbridge
description: LocalBridge exposes your VS Code workspace as a remote MCP server via ngrok

commands.title: LocalBridge: Copy Connector URL (with token, for Claude)

localbridge.autoStart.description: Automatically start localbridge when a workspace folder is opened.

localbridge.mcp.port.description: Local MCP HTTP port (0 = pick a free port).

localbridge.mcp.requireAuth.description: Require localbridge MCP token on every /mcp request. Set false only if your MCP client cannot send headers or URL tokens (less secure on ngrok).

localbridge.ngrok.enabled.description: Try to expose MCP via ngrok when an authtoken is available. If ngrok fails or no token is set, localbridge still starts on localhost.

localbridge.ngrok.authtoken.description: ngrok authtoken. Also reads NGROK_AUTHTOKEN or .vscode/.env in the extension install folder (see README for F5).

localbridge.ngrok.domain.description: Optional reserved ngrok domain (static URL), e.g. my-app.ngrok-free.app. Also reads NGROK_DOMAIN from .vscode/.env. Falls back to a random ngrok URL if unavailable.

localbridge.maxWriteFileSize.description: Maximum content size (bytes) for write_file and create_file.

localbridge.maxSearchFileSize.description: Maximum file size (bytes) searched by search_file.

localbridge.auditLogEnabled.description: Record local audit metadata for MCP operations (no file contents or secrets).

localbridge.contextEnabled.description: Enable agent-independent shared project context tools.

localbridge.searchRespectGitignore.description: When true, search_file will respect .gitignore patterns (experimental).

scripts.test: tsx --test src/workspace/security.test.ts src/workspace/filesystem.test.ts src/workspace/search.test.ts src/workspace/directories.test.ts src/ngrok/config.test.ts src/mcp/clientLabel.test.ts src/auth/authenticationManager.test.ts src/filesystem/contentHash.test.ts src/security/workspaceManager.test.ts
